text: col Stroke/text colour, gradient linear_gradient() / radial_gradient() stroke gradient — paint model fill, applied stroked region instead enclosed one. gradient affects stroked paths; text markers fall back first stop, since glyph run path run ramp along. fill Fill colour, gradient linear_gradient() / radial_gradient(). lwd Line width (1 == 1/96 inch). alpha Opacity multiplier [0, 1]. lty Line type: name ("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash"), integer code 0:6, hex dash string (e.g. "44"), numeric vector /dash lengths. Dash lengths scale lwd. lineend Line cap: "round" (default), "butt", "square". linejoin Line join: "round" (default), "mitre", "bevel". linemitre Mitre limit (>= 1) mitre joins; default 10. fontfamily Font family (text grobs). fontface One "plain", "bold", "italic", "bold.italic". fontsize Font size points. cex Multiplier applied fontsize (grid semantics), theme can ask relative size without knowing base one. cex = 2 exactly equivalent doubling fontsize: scales drawn text, char/line units, grobwidth()/grobheight() measurement alike. NULL (default) means 1. lineheight Line-height multiple. halo_col Halo colour text ("shadowtext" outline drawn glyphs, label stays legible dense marks map imagery). NULL (default) means halo. Needs halo_width visible. halo_width Halo thickness points – visible width outside glyph. NULL 0 means halo. good starting point roughly eighth fontsize. features OpenType font features, named numeric vector four-character feature tags – e.g. c(tnum = 1) tabular (fixed-width) figures axis labels stop jittering ticks, c(smcp = 1) small caps, c(onum = 1) oldstyle figures, c(liga = 0) switch ligatures , c(kern = 0) disable kerning. NULL (default) uses font's defaults. feature font carry silently ignored – HarfBuzz's behaviour, something vellum can check . antialias Anti-alias element's edges? NULL (default) inherits; root default TRUE. FALSE gives hard pixel edges, pixel art, QR codes, heatmap cells must tile without seam want. crisp Snap axis-parallel strokes onto pixel grid? NULL (default) inherits; root default FALSE. 1-px rule fractional coordinate straddles two pixel rows renders two grey ones rather one solid — reason gridlines look muddy screen. TRUE snaps horizontal vertical runs land whole pixels. Diagonals unaffected (grid snap ), applies raster output — vector format pixel grid. dash_phase far dash pattern dashed line starts, multiple lwd (scales line width exactly dash nibbles ). Use line dashes across adjacent strokes, animate marching ants. NULL (default) means 0. Ignored solid line.
